How to useVideo prompts

Video Prompts · Morning Routine, 1770

Petersburg with Catherine · one 6-second Grok Imagine video per image · 16:9 · 720p

169 video generations139 with dialogue30 silent (voice-over in edit)5 edit-onlyCut runtime ~11:07

How to use

  1. Attach only the graded start image named on the card (for example S24a_START.png, the image you made from the matching image prompt).
  2. Paste the card's prompt and generate one 6-second clip.
  3. Every clip is generated at 6 seconds. Trim it to the length on the card (TRIM TO) in the edit. Dialogue is timed to finish before that point.
  4. Dialogue shots speak their own line. Silent shots are cutaways under Catherine's voice-over: record that line separately and lay it over the clip in the edit.
  5. Edit-only cards (montages) need no generation.

Video prompts one card per 6-second shot
